## What's Changed * feat(clients): redesigned chat tables on iOS and Mac; bare URLs become links by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/401
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.66...mac-v0.2.67

## What's Changed * fix(apple): notification test-host guard compiles in Release by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/390 * Windows fixes from a clean Windows 11 VM E2E (Tentacle 0.35.9, Mac 0.2.62) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/391 * Proxy support: sign-in and relay connection through HTTPS_PROXY or the macOS system proxy (Tentacle 0.35.10, head 0.19.4, Mac 0.2.63) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/392 * Web: new Kraki logo and icons by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/393 * fix(clients): quiet reconnect and catch-up; voice waits for the connection by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/396 * fix(voice): harden shared Mac/iOS capture and transport by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/397 * design(native): permission prompt matches the question style by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/400 * fix(native): session styling, persistent indicators and floating voice composer by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/399 * Agents: show only what's installed; all supported agents in a separate view (Mac + CLI) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/394 * Mac: start sessions from a composer (idle pane + New Session sheet redesign) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/395 * Release: Tentacle 0.35.11, Mac 0.2.66 — agents list shows what's installed; new-session composer; Connect your phone by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/403
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/v0.35.8...mac-v0.2.66

## Native UI polish — macOS and iOS
- Refined session-preview icons while preserving alignment and compacting animation timing. - Long model names truncate from the beginning, preserving the useful suffix. Device names and thinking levels remain readable. - Session and Chat scroll indicators stay visible throughout scrolling, then hold for 1.2 seconds before fading. - Tighter, balanced spacing above and below the resting composer: 12pt on Mac, 6pt on iOS excluding the system safe area. - Voice transcription and multiline input expand as native Liquid Glass overlays without pushing chat bubbles upward. Existing composer controls and bottom placement are preserved. - Approval prompts now share the question card’s typography and capsule-button style (upstream #400).
Includes native regression coverage for glyphs, metadata, indicators, composer geometry, history reading, voice behavior and chat follow-tail. Style batch: [#399](https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/399).
### Updating
- Existing Mac users: **Kraki → Check for Updates…** - New Mac installations: download **Kraki.dmg** and drag Kraki to Applications. - Companion iOS build: **0.1.20**, delivered through TestFlight after Apple processing.
Mac **0.2.65 (67)** — signed, universal (Apple Silicon + Intel) and notarized. Built-in Tentacle remains version-locked to the release commit.
